name: page-catalog-previews
goal: Implemented page cards show their own recorded screenshot at the selected revision; planned pages keep their design preview.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The catalog selects only plan images and leaves implemented pages blank despite existing sealed screenshots. Bind each visual unit to scenario, state and viewport; retain tested-commit provenance and plan previews.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unchanged catalog regression returns null instead of the recorded thumbnail; the manifest rejects preview bindings. Logs: page-preview-images/catalog-red.log and manifest-red.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Bound page cards to exact recorded screenshots, kept planning designs, and added pinned-state validation, cleanup and signature selection guards.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Catalog, manifest, binding and collision regressions pass. Browser: 7 passed across local/hosted desktop, tablet, mobile, historical and missing evidence. Strict gate tests reject invalid previews; Mac signing rejects unavailable identities.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Diagnose plan overlays that hide implemented page screenshots.
steps.evidence: CatalogService overlays every plan through planCatalog, but the existing catalog test called catalogUnit only. Extend that standardized test with draft and imageless versions, planned-only controls and valid image precedence before repair.

steps.title: Prove recorded previews survive draft and imageless plan overlays.
steps.evidence: The strengthened existing catalog-listing test fails on the real CatalogService overlay: implemented page thumbnail becomes null for a draft plan. Planned-only and latest-image controls remain in the same test. Log: /tmp/harness-plan-overlay-red-20261017.log.

steps.title: Pass unchanged catalog overlay and shared app preview checks.
